OpcodeWindow.doc: Window-function execution opcodes. Thin shell over VdbeState's window_* methods. None emit rows — window output is written into a register via WindowValue and flows through the compiler's projection pipeline.

WindowOpen.doc: Allocate a window session at slot. The compiler emits a matching WindowClose at partition boundary and re-opens for the next partition.

WindowStep.doc: Feed the current row into the window session. For rank-style kinds (RowNumber/Rank/DenseRank), arg_reg is None. For Aggregate(_), arg_reg names the register whose value feeds the inner aggregate step. None arg for an Aggregate window is allowed (compiler emits on no-argument aggregates like COUNT(*) OVER (...)); state treats it as standard NULL-skip input.

WindowValue.doc: Read the current window-function value into regs[dest_reg]. RowNumber/Rank/DenseRank → Integer. Aggregate(kind) → the aggregate's current value under kind (same shape rules as AggValue).

WindowPartitionKey.doc: Read the stored key_idx-th component of the current partition-key tuple into regs[dest_reg]. Used by the outer scan to compare against the next row's partition keys.

WindowClose.doc: Release the window session at slot. Idempotent — closing an already-closed slot is a no-op.

execute.doc: Execute one window-family opcode. Always returns Continue on the happy path; no jumps or halts emitted by this family (bounds-check surfaces OpcodeIllegal only via structural target layer, unreachable in well-formed code).
